description: Phase 3 trace prompts: 16 per category, 6 categories. Every prompt was written for this repository (no third-party text). Categories: en = English prose, ar_msa = Modern Standard Arabic, ar_gulf = Gulf Arabic dialect, code = source code in several languages, math = arithmetic/algebra/calculus word problems, chat = conversational questions. Generation is greedy with a fixed number of new tokens (configs/phase3.json).
